sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING  ORDER This petition is filed by the accused under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for granting the bail in crime No.272/2021 registered by Gudibande Police and charge sheeted for the offences under Section 376(2)(i)(N) of IPC Section 5(L)(M) and Section 6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and Section 9, 10 of Prohibition of child Marriage Act.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned High Court Government Pleader for the State.
3.

It is the case of the prosecution that on the complaint of one Adinarayanaappa teacher informed the Police on 27.12.2021 alleging that, the victim girl was married by this petitioner and other accused performed the marriage of the victim girl on 10.11.2021 at Halegu village, Gudibande taluk,
after arresting the petitioner on 05.01.2021, he was remanded to Judicial Custody.
The police investigated and filed the charge sheet.
The petitioner was before this Court for bail and withdrawn the petition with liberty to approach this Court after examination of the victim.
Now the petitioner is before this Court with a successive bail petition on the ground the victim was already examined before the Trial Court on 13.02.2022.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits though the FIR has been registered against the petitioner for the alleged offences under 376 of IPC and POCSO Act, but 164 statement has not revealed any sexual assault and the victim also examined before this Court she has not given any evidence before this Court about any sexual assault.

Except the offences under the child marriage Sri. Manjuntha vs State Of Karnataka on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156870673/
2 Act, the other offences are not attracted.

sentences.text: Hence, prayed for bail.
5. Per contra learned High Court Government Pleader opposed and sought to dismiss the petition.

6. Heard the learned counsels and perused the material on record.
7.
On perusal of records, especially the complaint filed by the teacher who has alleged that the petitioner said to be a handicapped person married the victim girl who is only 11 years of age.
Subsequently, a nuptial ceremony, also arranged.
Hence, the complaint came to be filed.

Though the police investigated the matter and filed charge sheet under Section 376 of IPC and sec.6 of POCSO Act, but in 164 statement of the victim girl she has not stated anything about the sexual or physical assault by the petitioner and she stated that there is no intercourse between them.

Likewise the Trial commenced, that the victim was examined as PW-1 where she has given evidence before the Court and she has turned hostile and not supported the prosecution and she has also stated that there is no sexual assault on her.
Considering the facts and circumstances except the prohibition of Child Marriage Act, no other offences are made over.
Petitioner was in custody for more than 01 year 03 months and considering the fact that the petitioner is a handicapped person, and he is in jail for more than 01 year 03 months.
Hence, the petitioner is entitled for bail.
8. Hence, petition is allowed.
The trial court is directed to release the accused No.1 on bail subject to following conditions.

Sd/-
